- A real place (a city, a building, a route, a zoom from the globe to a street) is shown on real imagery. Vector outlines from Natural Earth or GeoJSON read as a diagram and lose the place; keep them for borders and labels drawn on top.
- Use only already installed puppeteer-core, FFmpeg and Chrome; report missing prerequisites instead of downloading them. Live tiles change between renders, so bake the camera move to video with `scripts/bake-basemap.mjs` (MapLibre over Esri satellite or Carto tiles; writes an all-intra MP4 and `<NAME>-coords.json`). From space down to a street: `PROJECTION=globe FROM="lng,lat" CENTER="lng,lat" ZSTART=1.85 ZEND=16` (Earth in a starfield turns from FROM to CENTER, then dives); `--help` lists the rest. It needs network for the tiles and takes well under a second a frame, so bake once, keep the MP4, and run one bake at a time. Draw borders, pins and labels as a live SVG from those coordinates, animating them only while the camera holds.
- Credit the imagery on screen ("Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics" or "© CARTO, © OpenStreetMap") in small type on a soft dark backing, so it holds contrast over bright tiles; mark it `data-layout-ignore` so the type floor in `check` skips it.
